identity_boundary: Capture IDs and physical ordinals differ; names, pixel fingerprints and appearance IDs do not establish serverID. Duplicate names remain separate rows.
missing_value_policy: Unobserved fields are not zero,false,N/A or intrinsic absence. Narrative descriptions stay private with exact UTF8 hash/length.

field_export_policy.boundary: Description remains an observed value retained1:1 privately; hash and UTF8 length are exported instead of narrative text. It is not UNKNOWN, N/A, zero or absent. Full repository literal-text parity is not claimed.
